indicators.privacy: The value is normalized and hashed by the local backend to find an exact match. It is not stored, logged or opened.
indicators.invalidValue: This value is not a valid indicator of the selected type.
indicators.hashOnly: Seen only in scans: stored as a hash, no plain value is kept.
indicators.openInIncidents: Open the Incidents tab to review these incidents.
indicators.communityHelp: Confirming records the value as a community indicator. It never adds it to the threat database used for scan verdicts.
indicators.noPending: No reports are waiting for review.
indicators.reportValueInvalid: The reported value is not valid for the selected type.

error.invalidInput: Check the link and message length, then try again.
error.tooMany: Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.
error.requestFailed: We could not complete the request. Please try again.

advice.heading: What to do next
LOW: No known warning signs were found. This does not guarantee the content is safe.
Never share passwords, card details or verification codes.
MEDIUM: Verify the message through the official app or a contact number you already trust.
Avoid using the link or phone number in the message.
HIGH: Do not open the link, reply or share any verification codes.
Contact the organization through its official app or website.
If you already shared details, contact your bank immediately and change affected passwords.
INCOMPLETE: Some required checks were unavailable. Treat the message with caution.
Verify through the official app or a trusted number, or try again later.
advice.senderType: Banks normally send messages under their company name, but sender names can be faked. Verify through the official app or a number you already trust.
